description: Election Commission - Declare that R. Chandrabose as a member of the Rattota Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Rattota Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party. The content specifically relates to electoral processes under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including the nomination and declaration of a new elected member. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral matters at the local government level.
